verses.text: Di whole earth get one language and one speech.
As dem dey travel from di east, dem find one plain for di land of Shinar, and dem settle there.
Dem talk to each other say, “Come, make we make bricks and burn dem well well.” Dem use brick for stone, and dem use tar for mortar.
Dem talk say, “Come, make we build one city for us, and one tower wey im top go reach heaven, and make we make name for ourselves, so that we no go scatter over di surface of all di earth.”
Di Lord come down to see di city and di tower wey di pikin dem of men dey build.
Di Lord talk say, “Look, di people na one, and dem all get one language, and dis na di beginning of wetin dem go do. Now nothing wey dem plan to do go dey impossible for dem.
Come, make we go down, and confuse dem language there, so that dem no go understand each other speech.”
So di Lord scatter dem from there over di surface of all di earth, and dem stop to build di city.
Na for dis reason dem call im name Babel, because there di Lord confuse di language of all di earth. From there di Lord scatter dem over di surface of all di earth.
Dis na di generations of Shem. Shem dey 100 years old, and e born Arpachshad two years after di flood.
Shem live 500 years after e born Arpachshad, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
Arpachshad live 35 years, and e born Shelah.
Arpachshad live 403 years after e born Shelah, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
Shelah live 30 years, and e born Eber.
Shelah live 403 years after e born Eber, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
Eber live 34 years, and e born Peleg.
Eber live 430 years after e born Peleg, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
Peleg live 30 years, and e born Reu.
Peleg live 209 years after e born Reu, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
Reu live 32 years, and e born Serug.
Reu live 207 years after e born Serug, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
Serug live 30 years, and e born Nahor.
Serug live 200 years after e born Nahor, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
Nahor live 29 years, and e born Terah.
Nahor live 119 years after e born Terah, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
Terah live 70 years, and e born Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
Now dis na di generations of Terah. Terah born Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran born Lot.
Haran die before im papa Terah for di land of im birth, for Ur of di Chaldees.
Abram and Nahor marry wives. Di name of Abram wife na Sarai, and di name of Nahor wife na Milcah, di pikin woman of Haran, di papa of Milcah and di papa of Iscah.
Sarai no fit born pikin. E no get pikin.

Terah take im pikin Abram, im grandpikin Lot, di pikin of Haran, and im pikin wife Sarai, di wife of im pikin Abram. Dem go out together from Ur of di Chaldees to go di land of Canaan. Dem come reach Haran and dwell there.
Di days of Terah na 205 years, and Terah die for Haran.
Now di Lord talk to Abram say, “Leave your country, your relatives, and your papa house, go to di land wey I go show you.
I go make you become great nation. I go bless you and make your name great. You go be blessing.
I go bless dem wey bless you, and dem wey curse you I go curse. For you all di families of di earth go dey blessed.”
So Abram go as di Lord talk to am, and Lot go with am. Abram dey 75 years old when e leave Haran.
Abram take im wife Sarai, and Lot im brother pikin, and all di property wey dem gather, and di people wey dem get for Haran, and dem go out to go di land of Canaan. Dem reach di land of Canaan.
Abram pass through di land to di place Shechem, to di oak of Moreh. Di Canaanites dey di land dat time.
Di Lord appear to Abram, talk say, “To your seed I go give dis land.” For there e build altar to di Lord, wey appear to am.
From there e move go di mountain for di east of Bethel, and pitch im tent, with Bethel for di west, and Ai for di east. For there e build altar to di Lord and call on di Lord name.
Abram journey on, still going toward di South.
Famine dey for di land. Abram go down to Egypt to stay there, because di famine dey severe for di land.
When e dey near to enter Egypt, e talk to im wife Sarai say, “Look now, I know say you na fine woman to look at.
When di Egyptians see you, dem go talk say, ‘Dis na im wife.’ Dem go kill me, but dem go keep you alive.
Make you talk say you na my sister, so that e go dey well with me for your sake, and my soul go live because of you.”
When Abram enter Egypt, di Egyptians see say di woman fine well well.
Pharaoh princes see am, and dem praise am to Pharaoh, and dem take di woman go Pharaoh house.
E treat Abram well for her sake. E get sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.
Di Lord strike Pharaoh and im house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram wife.
Pharaoh call Abram, talk say, “Wetin be dis wey you don do to me? Why you no tell me say na your wife?
Why you talk say, ‘Na my sister,’ so that I take am to be my wife? Now, look, your wife dey here. Take am, and go.”
Pharaoh give im men command concerning am, and dem send am away with im wife and all wey e get.
Abram go up out of Egypt, e, and im wife, and all wey e get, and Lot with am, go di South.
Abram rich well well for cattle, for silver, and for gold.
E go on im journeys from di South even to Bethel, to di place wia im tent dey for di beginning, between Bethel and Ai,
to di place of di altar wey e make there before. For there Abram call on di name of di Lord.
Lot too, wey dey go with Abram, get flocks, herds, and tents.
Di land no fit carry dem so that dem go dwell together, because dem property plenty, so dem no fit dwell together.
Quarrel dey between di herdsmen of Abram cattle and di herdsmen of Lot cattle. Di Canaanites and di Perizzites dey dwell for di land dat time.
Abram talk to Lot say, “Make quarrel no dey between me and you, and between my herdsmen and your herdsmen, because we na brothers.
Di whole land no dey before you? Make you separate yourself from me. If you go di left, I go go di right; or if you go di right, I go go di left.”

Lot lift up im eyes, and see all di plain of di Jordan, say e get plenty water everywhere, before di Lord destroy Sodom and Gomorrah, like di garden of di Lord, like di land of Egypt, as you go toward Zoar.
So Lot choose all di plain of di Jordan for himself. Lot travel go east, and dem separate from each other.
Abram dwell for di land of Canaan, and Lot dwell for di cities of di plain, and pitch im tent near Sodom.
Now di men of Sodom dey wicked and dem dey sin well well against di Lord.
Di Lord talk to Abram, after Lot separate from am, say, “Lift up your eyes now, and look from di place wia you dey, north, south, east, and west,
because all di land wey you see, I go give am to you and to your seed forever.
I go make your seed like di dust of di earth, so that if person fit count di dust of di earth, your seed go dey counted too.
Get up, waka through di land for im length and for im width, because I go give am to you.”
Abram move im tent, and come dwell by di oaks of Mamre, wey dey Hebron, and for there e build altar to di Lord.
For di days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim,
dem make war with Bera, king of Sodom, Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and di king of Bela, wey na Zoar.
All dis one join together for di Valley of Siddim, wey na di Salt Sea.
Dem serve Chedorlaomer 12 years, and for di 13th year dem rebel.
For di 14th year Chedorlaomer come, with di kings wey dey with am, and dem strike di Rephaim for Ashteroth Karnaim, di Zuzim for Ham, di Emim for Shaveh Kiriathaim,
and di Horites for dem Mount Seir, as far as El Paran, wey dey by di wilderness.
Dem return and come to En Mishpat, wey na Kadesh, and strike all di country of di Amalekites, and also di Amorites wey dey dwell for Hazazon Tamar.
Di king of Sodom, di king of Gomorrah, di king of Admah, di king of Zeboiim, and di king of Bela, wey na Zoar, go out; and dem arrange for battle for di Valley of Siddim,
against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar: four kings against five.
Di Valley of Siddim full of tar pits, and di kings of Sodom and Gomorrah run, and some fall inside am, and di rest run go di mountain.
Dem take all di goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all dem food, and go dem way.
Dem take Lot, Abram brother pikin, wey dey dwell for Sodom, and im goods, and go dem way.
One wey escape come tell Abram di Hebrew. Now e dey dwell by di oaks of Mamre di Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner; and dem na allies of Abram.
When Abram hear say dem don take im relative captive, e arm im trained men, wey dem born for im house, 318, and chase dem go as far as Dan.
E divide im men against dem for night, e and im servants, and strike dem, and chase dem go as far as Hobah, wey dey for di left of Damascus.
E bring back all di goods, and e bring back im relative Lot too, with im goods, and di women also, and di other people.
Di king of Sodom go out to meet am, after e return from di defeat of Chedorlaomer and di kings wey dey with am, for di Valley of Shaveh, wey na di King Valley.
Melchizedek, king of Salem, bring out bread and wine. Now e na priest of God Most High.
E bless am, talk say, “Blessed be Abram by God Most High, wey own heaven and earth.
Blessed be God Most High, wey don deliver your enemies into your hand.” E give am tenth of all.
Di king of Sodom talk to Abram say, “Give me di people, and take di goods for yourself.”
Abram talk to di king of Sodom say, “I don lift up my hand to di Lord, God Most High, wey own heaven and earth,
say I no go take anything wey be yours, from thread even to sandal strap, so that you no go talk say, ‘I don make Abram rich.’
I no go take anything except wetin di young men don eat, and di share of di men wey go with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Make dem take dem share.”
After dis things, di Lord word come to Abram for vision, talk say, “No fear, Abram. I na your shield, and your very great reward.”
Abram talk say, “Di Lord God, wetin you go give me, seeing say I dey go without pikin, and di heir of my house na Eliezer of Damascus?”
Abram talk say, “Look, you no give me any seed, and look, one wey born for my house na my heir.”
Look, di Lord word come to am, talk say, “Dis one no go be your heir; but one wey go come out of your own body go be your heir.”
E bring am outside, talk say, “Look now toward heaven, and count di stars, if you fit count dem.” E talk to am say, “So your seed go be.”
E believe di Lord, and e count am as righteousness.
E talk to am say, “I na di Lord wey bring you out of Ur of di Chaldees, to give you dis land to inherit am.”
E talk say, “Di Lord God, how I go know say I go inherit am?”
E talk to am say, “Take for me one heifer three years old, one female goat three years old, one ram three years old, one turtledove, and one young pigeon.”
E take all dis to am, cut dem for di middle, and put each piece opposite di other, but di birds e no cut.
Birds of prey come down on di carcasses, and Abram drive dem away.
When di sun dey go down, deep sleep fall on Abram; and look, terror of great darkness fall on am.
E talk to Abram say, “Know for sure say your seed go dey stranger for land wey no be dem own, and go serve dem, and dem go afflict dem 400 years.
Also di nation wey dem go serve, I go judge, and after dat dem go come out with great possessions.
But you, you go join your papa dem for peace. Dem go bury you for good old age.
For di fourth generation dem go come back here again, because di iniquity of di Amorites never reach full.”
E come be say when di sun don set, and e dey dark, look, one smoking furnace, and one flaming torch pass between dem pieces.
For dat same day di Lord make covenant with Abram, talk say, “To your seed I don give dis land, from di river of Egypt to di great river, di river Euphrates:
di Kenites, di Kenizzites, di Kadmonites,
di Hittites, di Perizzites, di Rephaim,
di Amorites, di Canaanites, di Girgashites, and di Jebusites.”
Now Sarai, Abram wife, no born pikin for am. E get one Egyptian servant, wey im name na Hagar.
Sarai talk to Abram say, “Look now, di Lord don stop me from born pikin. Go enter my servant. Maybe I go get pikin by am.” Abram listen to Sarai voice.
Sarai, Abram wife, take Hagar di Egyptian, im servant, after Abram don dwell ten years for di land of Canaan, and give am to Abram im husband to be im wife.
E go enter Hagar, and e become pregnant. When Hagar see say e don become pregnant, e begin despise im madam.

Sarai talk to Abram say, “Di wrong wey dem do me dey on you. I give my servant into your arms, and now e see say e don become pregnant, I dey despise for im eyes. Make di Lord judge between me and you.”
But Abram talk to Sarai say, “Look, your servant dey your hand. Do to am wetin good for your eyes.” Sarai treat am hard, and Hagar run from im face.
Di Lord angel find am by one spring of water for di wilderness, di spring wey dey di way to Shur.
E talk say, “Hagar, Sarai servant, wia you dey come from, and wia you dey go?” E talk say, “I dey run from my madam Sarai.”
Di Lord angel talk to am say, “Return to your madam, and submit yourself under im hands.”
Di Lord angel talk to am say, “I go greatly multiply your seed, so tay dem no go fit count am for plenty.”
Di Lord angel talk to am say, “Look, you don become pregnant, and you go born one pikin man. You go call im name Ishmael, because di Lord don hear your affliction.
E go be wild donkey of man. Im hand go dey against everyone, and everyone hand against am. E go dwell for presence of all im brothers.”
E call di name of di Lord wey talk to am, “You na God wey see me,” because e talk say, “I still dey alive here after I see am wey dey see me?”
Na dis reason dem call di well Beer Lahai Roi. Look, e dey between Kadesh and Bered.
Hagar born one pikin man for Abram, and Abram call im pikin wey Hagar born, Ishmael.
Abram dey 86 years old when Hagar born Ishmael for Abram.
When Abram dey 99 years old, di Lord appear to Abram, talk say, “I na God Almighty. Waka before me, and be perfect.
I go make my covenant between me and you, and I go multiply you greatly.”
Abram fall on im face. God talk with am, say,
“As for me, look, my covenant dey with you, and you go be di papa of plenty nations.
Dem no go call your name Abram again, but your name go be Abraham, because I don make you papa of plenty nations.
I go make you very fruitful, and I go make nations of you. Kings go come out of you.
I go establish my covenant between me and you and your seed after you for dem generations for everlasting covenant, to be God to you and to your seed after you.
I go give to you, and to your seed after you, di land wia you dey stranger, all di land of Canaan, for everlasting possession. I go be dem God.”
God talk to Abraham say, “As for you, you go keep my covenant, you and your seed after you for dem generations.
Dis na my covenant, wey una go keep, between me and una and your seed after you: every male among una go circumcise.
Una go circumcise di flesh of una foreskin. E go be di sign of di covenant between me and una.
Eight days old, every male among una go circumcise for una generations, di one wey born for house, or wey dem buy with money from any foreigner wey no be your seed.
Di one wey born for your house and di one wey dem buy with your money must circumcise. My covenant go dey for una flesh for everlasting covenant.
Di uncircumcised male wey im foreskin dem no circumcise, dat soul go dey cut off from im people. E don break my covenant.”
God talk to Abraham say, “As for Sarai your wife, you no go call im name Sarai, but Sarah go be im name.
I go bless am, and moreover I go give you one pikin man by am. Yes, I go bless am, and e go be mama of nations. Kings of peoples go come from am.”
Abraham fall on im face and laugh, and talk for im heart say, “Dem go born pikin to one wey dey 100 years old? Sarah, wey dey 90 years old, go born?”
Abraham talk to God say, “Oh make Ishmael live before you!”
God talk say, “No, but Sarah your wife go born you one pikin man. You go call im name Isaac. I go establish my covenant with am for everlasting covenant for im seed after am.
As for Ishmael, I don hear you. Look, I don bless am, and I go make am fruitful, and I go multiply am greatly. E go be papa of 12 princes, and I go make am great nation.
But my covenant I go establish with Isaac, wey Sarah go born to you at dis set time for next year.”
E finish talking with am, and God go up from Abraham.

Abraham take Ishmael im pikin, and all wey dem born for im house, and all wey dem buy with im money, every male among di men of Abraham house, and e circumcise di flesh of dem foreskin for di very same day, as God talk to am.
Abraham dey 99 years old when e circumcise di flesh of im foreskin.
Ishmael im pikin dey 13 years old when dem circumcise di flesh of im foreskin.
For di very same day Abraham circumcise, and Ishmael im pikin.
All di men of im house, wey dem born for di house, and wey dem buy with money from foreigner, circumcise with am.
Di Lord appear to am by di oaks of Mamre, as e sit for di tent door for di heat of di day.
E lift up im eyes and look, and see three men stand near am. When e see dem, e run from di tent door to meet dem, and bow down to di earth,
and talk say, “My oga, if now I don find favour for your eyes, make you no pass your servant by.
Make dem bring small water, and wash una feet, and rest una self under di tree.
I go bring one piece of bread, and refresh una hearts. After dat una fit pass, because na for dis reason una come to your servant.” Dem talk say, “Do as you talk.”
Abraham hurry go di tent to Sarah, talk say, “Quick, prepare three measures of fine flour, knead am, and make cakes.”
Abraham run go di herd, take one tender and good calf, give am to servant, and e hurry to prepare am.
E take butter and milk, and di calf wey e prepare, and set am before dem. E stand by dem under di tree, and dem eat.
Dem talk to am say, “Wia Sarah your wife dey?” E talk say, “Look, for di tent.”
E talk say, “I go surely return to you when di season come round. Look, Sarah your wife go get one pikin man.” Sarah dey hear for di tent door, wey dey behind am.
Now Abraham and Sarah don old, and dem don pass age. Sarah don stop to get di way of women.
Sarah laugh inside herself, talk say, “After I don old, I go get pleasure, my oga too don old?”
Di Lord talk to Abraham say, “Why Sarah laugh, talk say, ‘I go really born pikin, now I don old?’
Anything dey too hard for di Lord? For di set time I go return to you, when di season come round, and Sarah go get one pikin man.”
Den Sarah deny am, talk say, “I no laugh,” because e fear. E talk say, “No, but you laugh.”
Di men rise from there, and look toward Sodom. Abraham go with dem to send dem on dem way.
Di Lord talk say, “I go hide from Abraham wetin I dey do,
seeing say Abraham go surely become great and mighty nation, and all di nations of di earth go dey blessed for am?

Because I don choose am, so that e go command im pikin dem and im house after am, make dem keep di way of di Lord, to do righteousness and justice; so that di Lord go bring to Abraham wetin e don talk about am.”
Di Lord talk say, “Because di cry of Sodom and Gomorrah great, and because dem sin very grievous,
I go go down now, and see if dem don do altogether according to di cry of am, wey don come to me; and if no, I go know.”
Di men turn from there, and go toward Sodom, but Abraham still dey stand before di Lord.
Abraham come near, talk say, “You go destroy di righteous with di wicked?
Maybe 50 righteous dey inside di city. You go destroy am and no spare di place for di sake of di 50 righteous wey dey inside am?
Far be am from you to do dis kind thing, to kill di righteous with di wicked, so that di righteous go be like di wicked. Far be am from you. Di Judge of all di earth no go do right?”
Di Lord talk say, “If I find for Sodom 50 righteous inside di city, I go spare all di place for dem sake.”
Abraham answer, talk say, “Look now, I don take am for myself to talk to Lord, I wey be only dust and ashes.
Maybe di 50 righteous go lack five. You go destroy all di city for lack of five?” E talk say, “I no go destroy am if I find 45 dere.”
E talk to am again, talk say, “Maybe dem go find 40 dere.” E talk say, “I no go do am for di sake of di 40.”
E talk say, “Oh make Lord no vex, and I go talk. Maybe dem go find 30 dere.” E talk say, “I no go do am if I find 30 dere.”
E talk say, “Look now, I don take am for myself to talk to Lord. Maybe dem go find 20 dere.” E talk say, “I no go destroy am for di sake of di 20.”
E talk say, “Oh make Lord no vex, and I go talk just dis once. Maybe dem go find ten dere.” E talk say, “I no go destroy am for di sake of ten.”
Di Lord go im way as soon as e don finish to talk with Abraham, and Abraham return to im place.
Di two angels come to Sodom for evening. Lot dey sit for di gate of Sodom. When Lot see dem, e rise up to meet dem, and bow down im face to di earth.
E talk say, “Look now, my ogas, turn aside into your servant house, stay di night, and wash una feet. Una go rise early and go una way.” Dem talk say, “No, but we go stay for di street all night.”
E press dem well well, and dem turn aside to am, enter im house. E make feast for dem, bake unleavened bread, and dem eat.
But before dem lie down, di men of di city, di men of Sodom, surround di house, both young and old, all di people from every quarter.
Dem call Lot, talk to am say, “Wia di men dey wey come to you tonight? Bring dem out to us, so that we go know dem.”
Lot go out to dem for di door, and shut di door behind am.
E talk say, “My brothers, make una no do wicked thing.

Look now, I get two pikin woman dem wey never know man. Make I bring dem out to una, and una do to dem as e good for una eyes. Only to dis men do nothing, because dem don come under di shadow of my roof.”

Dem talk say, “Stand back!” Dem talk say, “Dis one come to stay as foreigner, and e don turn judge. Now we go deal worse with you pass dem.” Dem press hard against di man Lot, and come near to break di door.
But di men put out dem hand, pull Lot into di house to dem, and shut di door.
Dem strike di men wey dey di door of di house with blindness, both small and great, so dem tire to find di door.
Di men talk to Lot say, “You get anybody else here? Di men wey marry your pikin woman dem, your pikin man dem, your pikin woman dem, and whoever you get for di city, bring dem out of dis place,
because we go destroy dis place, because di cry of dem don great before di Lord, and di Lord don send us to destroy am.”
Lot go out, talk to di men wey marry im pikin woman dem, talk say, “Get up! Leave dis place, because di Lord go destroy di city.” But e dey like person wey dey joke to dem.
When morning come, di angels press Lot, talk say, “Get up, take your wife, and your two pikin woman dem wey dey here, so that you no go dey consumed for di punishment of di city.”
But as e dey delay, di men hold im hand, and im wife hand, and di hand of im two pikin woman dem, di Lord being merciful to am; and dem bring am out, and set am outside di city.
When dem don bring dem outside, e talk say, “Escape for your life! No look behind you, and no stay for any place for di plain. Escape go di mountain, so that you no go dey consumed.”
Lot talk to dem say, “Oh no, Lord.

Look now, your servant don find favour for your sight, and you don show your mercy, wey you show to me by saving my life. I no fit escape go di mountain, otherwise disaster go overtake me, and I go die.
Look now, dis city near to flee to, and e small. Make I escape there. E no be small one? My soul go live.”
E talk to am say, “Look, I don grant you dis request too, say I no go overthrow di city wey you talk about.
Hurry, escape there, because I no fit do anything until you reach there.” Na why dem call di name of di city Zoar.
Di sun don rise over di earth when Lot reach Zoar.
Den di Lord rain sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah, from di Lord out of heaven.
E overthrow dem cities, all di plain, all di people wey dey dwell for di cities, and wetin dey grow for di ground.
But im wife look back from behind am, and e become pillar of salt.
Abraham get up early for morning go di place wia e stand before di Lord.
E look toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all di land of di plain, and see, and look, smoke of di land rise up like smoke of furnace.
E come be say when God destroy di cities of di plain, God remember Abraham, and send Lot out of di midst of di overthrow, when e overthrow di cities wia Lot dey dwell.
Lot go up out of Zoar, and dwell for di mountain, and im two pikin woman dem with am, because e fear to dwell for Zoar. E dwell for one cave, e and im two pikin woman dem.
Di firstborn talk to di younger say, “Our papa don old, and no man dey for di earth to come enter us as e be di way of all di earth.
Come, make we make our papa drink wine, and make we sleep with am, so that we go keep seed alive from our papa.”
Dem make dem papa drink wine dat night. Di firstborn go in, sleep with im papa. E no know when e lie down or when e rise.

Di next day, di firstborn talk to di younger say, “Look, I sleep with my papa last night. Make we make am drink wine tonight too. You go in, sleep with am, so that we go keep seed alive from our papa.”
Dem make dem papa drink wine dat night too. Di younger rise up, sleep with am. E no know when e lie down or when e rise up.
Di two pikin woman dem of Lot become pregnant by dem papa.
Di firstborn born one pikin man, call im name Moab. Na im be di papa of di Moabites to dis day.
Di younger too born one pikin man, call im name Ben Ammi. Na im be di papa of di pikin dem of Ammon to dis day.
Abraham travel from there toward di land of di South, and dwell between Kadesh and Shur. E stay for Gerar as foreigner.
Abraham talk about im wife Sarah say, “Na my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar send, take Sarah.
But God come to Abimelech for dream for night, talk to am say, “Look, you na dead man, because of di woman wey you don take, because e na man wife.”
Now Abimelech never come near am. E talk say, “Lord, you go kill even righteous nation?
E no talk to me say, ‘Na my sister’? E herself talk say, ‘Na my brother.’ Na for integrity of my heart and innocence of my hands I do dis.”
God talk to am for dream, “Yes, I know say you do dis for integrity of your heart. I too keep you from sinning against me. Na why I no allow you touch am.
Now therefore restore di man wife. Because e na prophet, e go pray for you, and you go live. If you no restore am, know say you go surely die, you and all wey be your own.”
Abimelech rise early for morning, call all im servants, and tell all dis things for dem ears. Di men fear well well.
Den Abimelech call Abraham, talk to am say, “Wetin you don do to us? Wetin I do wrong to you, say you don bring on me and on my kingdom great sin? You don do to me deeds wey no suppose dey done.”
Abimelech talk to Abraham say, “Wetin you see, say you do dis thing?”
Abraham talk say, “Because I think say, surely di fear of God no dey for dis place, and dem go kill me for my wife sake.
Also, truly na my sister, di pikin woman of my papa, but no be di pikin woman of my mama, and e become my wife.
When God cause me to wander from my papa house, I talk to am say, ‘Dis na di kindness wey you go show me: for every place wia we go reach, talk about me say I na your brother.’”
Abimelech take sheep, cattle, male servants and female servants, and give dem to Abraham, and restore im wife Sarah to am.
Abimelech talk say, “Look, my land dey before you. Dwell wia e please you.”
To Sarah e talk say, “Look, I don give your brother 1,000 pieces of silver. Look, e na covering of di eyes for you to all wey dey with you, and for everyone. You dey vindicated.”
Abraham pray to God. God heal Abimelech, im wife, and im female servants, and dem born pikin.
Because di Lord don close up every womb of di house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham wife.
